title: Traders Are Piling Into These Stocks
speaker: Geeks of Finance host

macro_themes.view: S&P 8000 strike gamma acts as a magnet; low volatility makes it easier for buyers to step in.
Positively skewed GEX in BTC at 85k is a positive sign for risk assets.

calls.reason: Capped at 7700 gamma strike with negative flows, but trend grinding toward 8000 gamma magnet; 8000 is year-end target.
calls.quote: the trend clearly continuing to point towards that 8,000 strike. That's our year-end target

calls.reason: Negative gamma 15-16 strikes; sellers have stepped in on every spike above the 50-day EMA (~16).
calls.quote: We've seen selling pressure come in in volatility on every spike above that 50 EMA

calls.reason: Consolidating at the 85k gamma strike with GEX growing at higher strikes; inverse head-and-shoulders, 60k key pivot.
calls.quote: further consolidation around 85,000 could lead to another leg higher towards 90,000 or even 95,000

calls.reason: Broke out toward heavy LEAP gamma at 750/800; valuation model sees 1,000-1,500 in 2-3 years on revenue/EPS growth.
calls.quote: we could see Meta anywhere between 1,00 and 1,500 in the next 2 or 3 years

calls.reason: Capped at 620-630 with selling pressure and >100 pts above 50-day EMA; expects consolidation near 600, then gamma pull toward 700.
calls.quote: AMD has a little bit more risk to the downside in the near term, but the potential to get up here towards that 700 strike …

notes: Weekday not stated (mentions 'On Tuesday' profit lock and 'yesterday's sizable sell-off'); listing date used. META long-term target recorded as 1000 (low end of 1,000-1,500 range, 2-3y). META medium target 800 inferred from gamma strike 'breakout' framing; lower confidence.
